target_customer: Private credit funds, originators, servicers and other private capital managers
problem: Middle and back office work (borrowing base, loan tapes, NAV) is done by humans in spreadsheets and email, causing errors, fines and write-offs.
business_model: B2B enterprise software and agents, contracts with partners
product_category: AI agents for private credit operations

founders.name: Yogesh Gorjilla
founders.background_notes: Per YC page built a Pay Later product to 10 million users.

founders.name: Manoj Sarda
previous_startups: Skit.ai (voice AI for debt collection, outcome not stated)

competitors.name: Ellis AI
competitors.what: AI operations platform for private credit managers

competitors.name: F2
competitors.what: AI platform for private credit funds and banks

competitors.name: Hypercore
competitors.what: AI admin agent for private credit loan servicing
competitors.funding_then: 13.5M Series A led by Insight Partners, Feb 2026

competitors.traction_then: Early deployment at Pier Asset Management per its profile

technical_complexity.rationale: Parsing loan tapes and credit documents and producing audit-ready calculations needs accuracy, though built on LLM tooling.

defensibility.rationale: Integration into fund workflows and a multi-year TresVista contract help, but several funded competitors target the same wedge.

market_need_then: Private credit AUM grew sharply while operations still ran on spreadsheets; the company reports a customer cutting a 20 hour process to 30 minutes (self reported).

identity.voice_and_tone: Short punchy headlines such as Loan tapes, cracked

brand_strength.rationale: Name is easily misspelled and no press on the brand exists.

outcome_analysis: Elimentary is a Fall 2026 company with no outcome yet. The founders bring fintech and credit operating experience from large banks and Flipkart, and the YC page cites a multi-year contract with TresVista, which supports an enterprise sales route. Several better funded competitors launched private credit agents in 2026, so differentiation and speed will decide it.
notes: Dealroom lists about 125k raised, single aggregator, unverified. TresVista contract is stated only on the YC page.
